x: In the race promoted by Sutton and Cheam Harriers at Sutton on July 27th, three of our walkers, G. Beecham, E.
Team handicap—2nd, Belgrave " C " Team; Bellchamber, Beecham, Smith, Doubleday, 210.3.

George Beecham is to be heartily congratulated on his excellent performance which gave him the individual handicap. A bigger surprise awaited George when he received his prize later in the evening at the Club Dance (having left Imber Court before the awards were presented).
George Beecham won the 2 miles walk handicap with our old friend Harry Shields battling away to gain 2nd place from Bill True, the handicapper!
George Beecham gained his first National winning team medal, Hugh McGreechan the Sydney Bayliss Cup and Bob Newson his first (2nd Class) National Standard medal.
Green, Syd James, Bob Newson, Brian Shepherd, McGreechan and Beecham. Crossing Purley Way, Syd had moved up to Eric and Evans with Bob coming along like a rocket.

Hugh McGreechan was well up all the way followed by Bob Newson with Beecham and Norman a little way back. After a bad spell on the homeward journey, Mac recovered and beat George Coleman near home for 5th place.

Noticeable members of the latter pack were Harry Shields and George Beecham, holding a lively discussion on George's latest acquisition in gent's natty waistcoats, a superb creation in green and black satin, but not being worn during the race.
Meanwhile, George Beecham, revelling in the sunshine, came through to fourth with Hugh McGreechan and Bob Newson completing our scoring team in 6th and 7th positions.
Our 'B' team of Keown, Morris, Beecham, and Stevenson walked exceedingly well and only lost 3rd team position by 2 points. Will Belderson was awarded the Sir J.Coleman Cup.

John Knifton was 24th in Section A Barnes, Belderson, Beecham and Keown, 6th 7th 30th and 32nd respectively in Section B; Eglington, Cameron, McLennan, Duncan,Wilson and Doubleday between 18 and 62 in Section C; Bushman, East and Logan 14th,15th and 34th in Section D.

As a result the two Georges, Checkley and Beecham, gained international vests. Earlier in the year the runners had finished third in the Brighton relay and the Polytechnic marathon where the team included two of the editing trio.
